career_ladder.note: Head Constable (Radio Operator) and Head Constable (Radio Mechanic) serve in the Communication Wing of the Border Security Force (BSF) under the Ministry of Home Affairs. Personnel maintain tactical high-frequency (HF), very-high-frequency (VHF), and satellite communication networks across international borders. Promotion to Sub-Inspector and Inspector is based on departmental promotion committees and qualifying specialized technical courses.

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to Head Constable (RO) and Head Constable (RM) is conducted through a three-phase selection procedure: Phase I Written Examination (OMR / Computer-Based Test of 200 marks, 100 questions); Phase II Physical Standard Test (PST), Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Documentation, and Dictation/Reading Test for HC(RO); Phase III Detailed Medical Examination (DME) and Review Medical Examination (RME).

financial_package.note: Head Constable (RO/RM) posts are in Pay Level 4 (₹25,500 – ₹81,100) under the 7th CPC. Personnel are deployed across international borders and receive border allowances and ration entitlements.
financial_package.pay_source_label: 7th CPC Pay Matrix, Table 5 (Civilian & CAPF Personnel), Government of India
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 4 entry basic pay of ₹25,500 with 58% DA (₹14,790), HRA (10% to 30%), Transport Allowance (₹900 to ₹1,350 + DA on TA), plus Ration Money Allowance (~₹3,965/month) and Risk/Hardship Allowance applicable for border postings.
official_perks: Ration Money Allowance (RMA) / free field ration in border and operational locations
Special Compensatory / Risk & Hardship Allowance for postings in difficult and high-altitude border outposts
Hair Cutting / Soap / Toilet allowance and Annual Dress Allowance (₹10,000 per annum)
Free medical treatment for personnel and dependents in BSF Composite Hospitals
Subsidized purchasing through Central Police Canteen (CPC) network
Government accommodation / barracks with messing facilities
